The British Music Legends Series: Rolling Stones Gold Coin
Unearth a piece of British music history with our exquisite
Rolling Stones Gold Coin
from the coveted
British Music Legends Series
by the Royal Mint. A must-have for those looking to buy gold online and the perfect gift for any music lover, especially fans of the legendary Rolling Stones. As your trusted shop,
Bullion Trading LLC
offers you the chance to own this limited-edition piece of history.
Rolling Stones – A Symphony in Gold
Spanning generations, The Rolling Stones have been a core part of Britain’s soundtrack for 60 years. From their inception in 1962, they have been considered a rock ‘n’ roll institution and one of the biggest bands in the history of modern music. Flaunting an incredible catalog of hits that spans 60 years and counting, the band remains as popular today as they were at its formation. The Rolling Stones are timeless, with cross-generational popularity, and are undoubtedly true music legends.
For the first time ever, this iconic band’s unique design graces an official UK coin, available in a number of editions, sizes, and metals, creating a unique opportunity for collectors and investors alike.
British Music Legends Series
The wildly popular Music Legends Series from The Royal Mint showcases Great Britain’s diverse musical heritage through unique reverse designs. Previous releases include Queen, Elton John, David Bowie, and The Who. These releases are officially licensed and make the perfect gift for investors and collectors.
Rolling Stones Gold Coin Highlights
Contains 1 oz of .9999 fine Gold​
It is packaged in a protective plastic capsule​.
Obverse: Displays the fifth and final effigy of Her Late Majesty Queen Elizabeth II, along with the £100 face value.
Reverse: Features a design of the rockers’ silhouettes on stage and includes the classic 1973 ‘The Rolling Stones’ font. Along the bottom, “’62-’22” denotes the 60th anniversary of the iconic band’s formation.
Don’t miss out on this golden opportunity to own a piece of music history.
Buy gold online
from us at Bullion Trading LLC today and add the legendary Rolling Stones Gold Coin to your collection.
